events.title: 1st Muchinga Youth Summit
events.description: Organized and attended the landmark 1st Muchinga Youth Summit, bringing together young people from across the province to foster leadership, skills development, and civic engagement. Graced by the Provincial Youth Coordinator as the chief guest, the event served as a collaborative platform for youth empowerment and was successfully executed through generous corporate sponsorship from National Savings and Credit Bank (NATSAVE) and Indo-Zambian Bank.

events.label: Cultural Festival
events.title: Muchinga Cultural Festival
events.description: invited to speak at the Muchinga Cultural Festival alongside the District Commissioners of Nakonde and Mpika, where I delivered an address inspiring young people to embrace their rich cultural heritage as a fundamental pillar of African identity.

events.label: Summit
events.title: 2026 Youth SDG Summit
events.description: In the Room, On the Panel: Shaping the Narrative at the 2026 Youth SDG Summit.
events.details:
I will be at the Government Complex in Lusaka for the 2026 Youth SDG Summit not just to observe, but to sit in the room where decisions are deliberated and share the discussion panel with incredible leaders, policy architects, and innovators.   

Across Africa, young people are sitting directly at the intersection of our most urgent societal challenges and our most promising solutions. From digital innovation and green technology to policy advocacy, youth are no longer just the subject of development talks we are active co-creators of the outcome.

What We’re Bringing to the Table Sharing a discussion panel with leading minds at this year's summit offers an opportunity to push past generic discourse and focus on actionable execution: Intersectionality of Youth Leadership: Exploring how young innovators operate across climate action, digital equity, and economic empowerment simultaneously.

Direct Dialogue with Policymakers: Collaborating with strategic institutional partners including the Ministry of Youth, Sport & Arts, the Ministry of Green Economy & Environment, and the UNDP to move from recommendations to concrete implementation.   

Scaling Grassroots Models: Highlighting how community-level initiatives can be funded, scaled, and integrated into national SDG strategies. True impact happens when bold ideas meet collaborative platforms. I look forward to contributing to these crucial panel discussions and building lasting partnerships.

Attending the 2026 Youth SDG Summit or leading SDG-aligned initiatives? Reach out directly via the contact page or connect on LinkedIn to collaborate!

It doesn't only take one or two people to change the narrative, but together so we can and 

I Remain,
Mwewa Mwewa 🇿🇲
